title: Fix Guided Setup first-run config creation
summary: Allow the backend-owned Settings Guided Setup flow to preview and create an initial per-user PSD1 in package first-run mode without weakening normal settings patch fail-close behavior.
reason: Portable packages intentionally do not ship a live operator config, but the wizard delegated preview/save to the normal patch pipeline, which requires an already verified active config and made first-run setup impossible.
behavior_before: Guided Setup path/tool validation could pass, but Preview Config failed against an empty base config and Save & Reload failed because the active AppData PSD1 was missing and unverified.
behavior_after: Guided Setup previews against a full template/default base when no live config exists and can create the missing per-user PSD1 through a wizard-only first-run path after backend validation.
manual_validation: PYTHONPATH=src ops/scripts/smoke/Test-WebViewBrowserSettingsLaunchSmoke.ps1 - blocked by unrelated Library Route Map evidence-panel table sort/filter/resizer buttons before wizard assertions
PYTHONPATH=src ops/scripts/smoke/Test-WebViewBrowserSettingsLaunchSmoke.ps1 - passed after MP-CHANGE-2026-0613-006 route-map evidence-panel fix
real-template first-run wizard validation via temporary missing config target - passed: preview ok, save ok, saved PSD1 reloaded with 137 keys
rollback_plan: Revert the wizard first-run preview/save changes, targeted tests, generated summaries, and this change packet.
notes: Keep normal settings.save_patch verified-config guard intact. Do not add frontend-owned filesystem or settings persistence behavior.
